newsitem.title: GERMANY: October W. German state inflation due from Thurs.
newsitem.headline: October W. German state inflation due from Thurs.

text.p: Regional west German inflation data for October will be released from Thursday, state statistics offices said on Wednesday.
The state of North Rhine-Westphalia said it would probably release its data towards the afternoon. Baden-Wuerttemberg said it was looking to publish its figures around midday.
The state of Bavaria said it was also likely to publish its data on Thursday but could not give a more precise time.
The state of Hesse said it would release its data early on Thursday.
Data from the four states are used to calculate preliminary west German consumer inflation.
In September, consumer price inflation in Germany stood at 1.4 percent year on year.
